scope.summary: Plan one fixed one-shot real Codex experiment that composes native events, one clean fixture snapshot, one verification receipt, and the existing governed-run kernel without cohort or platform machinery.
non_goals: No five-run cohort, rates, denominator, human-friction measurement, tracked observation/report, or durable raw retention.
No concurrency, retry, resume, crash recovery, cross-process deduplication, global registry, supervisor service, or transactional multi-file publication.
No modification or integration of app runtime, public API, CLI, ToolRegistry, provider defaults, persistence, existing supervision kernel, or archived qualification.
No fake, synthetic, archived, subagent, or reviewer output may count as the one real observation or as human input.
No Agent access to RepoPilot or a user project as the target repository, no extra write root, dynamic controller argv, arbitrary shell text, danger bypass, or Agent Git delivery.
No product completion, semantic correctness, verified provenance, security isolation, provider-wide compatibility, human approval, product acceptance, release readiness, or Git delivery claim.
No real Agent launch, implementation, archive, commit, merge, or push in this authority epoch.
